{{short description|Supermarket and hypermarket chain in Saudi Arabia}} {{Coord|21|33|33|N|39|11|05|E|display=title}} {{Infobox company | name = Danube Company Limited | logo = Danube.png | type = Retailers | founded = {{start date and age|October 18, 1987}} | industry = [[Supermarket|Hypermarket]] | hq_location = [[Jeddah]], Saudi Arabia | key_people = AbdulRazzaq BinDawood
(Chairman), Ahmad AR. BinDawood (CEO) | owner = Bindawood Holding{{cite news |title=Saudi Arabia's BinDawood grocery retailer plans to list on Tadawul |url=https://www.thenationalnews.com/business/markets/saudi-arabia-s-bindawood-grocery-retailer-plans-to-list-on-tadawul-1.1070593 |work=The National |language=en}} | num_employees = | products = Retail - [[Supermarket|Hypermarket]] | website = {{url|danube.sa}} }} '''Danube Company Limited''' is a supermarket and [[hypermarket]] chain in Saudi Arabia. It is owned by BinDawood Holding, the grocery retail operator of hypermarkets and supermarkets in [[Saudi Arabia]].{{Cite web|last=Graham|first=Emma|date=2020-08-31|title=Saudi retailer BinDawood to list 20% of company on the kingdom's Tadawul exchange|url=https://www.cnbc.com/2020/08/31/saudi-retailer-bindawood-to-list-20percent-of-company-on-the-kingdoms-tadawul-exchange.html|access-date=2020-09-02|website=CNBC|language=en}} Since becoming part of BinDawood Holding in 2001, Danube has grown to 47{{Cite web|date=2020-12-31|title=Danube stores see 23.5% sales surge during pandemic|url=https://arab.news/5jnyq|access-date=2020-12-31|website=Arab News|language=en}} current locations.{{Cite web|date=2017-10-22|title=Majed Al-Tahan: At the cutting edge of Saudi Arabia's e-commerce revolution|url=https://www.arabnews.com/node/1181931/business-economy|access-date=2020-09-02|website=Arab News|language=en}} == Branches == Danube opened its first hypermarket at the [[Heraa International Mall]] in 1993 in Jeddah. Then, the branch moved to a hypermarket about 0.5 kilometres away from Heraa International Mall. Danube hypermarkets are located at Medina Road (originally Heraa International Mall), [[Serafi Megamall]], [[Redsea Mall]]{{Cite web |url=http://www.redseamall.com/hypermarket.php |title=Red Sea Mall |access-date=2011-11-23 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120218051035/http://redseamall.com/hypermarket.php |archive-date=2012-02-18 |url-status=dead }} and at [[Central Park Mall (Jeddah)|Central Park Mall]]{{cite web|url=http://www.olaat.com/index%20-News.html|title=Olat Development Co. Ltd|publisher=olaat.com|access-date=2015-04-10|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304044459/http://www.olaat.com/index%20-News.html|archive-date=2016-03-04|url-status=dead}}{{cite web|url=https://foursquare.com/v/danube-hypermarket--%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%88%D8%A8-%D9%87%D8%A7%D9%8A%D8%A8%D8%B1-%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B1%D9%83%D8%AA/4de1497ce4cd846e409f0e56|title=Danube Hypermarket | الدانوب هايبر ماركت - الفيحاء - جدة, Minţaqat Makkah|publisher=foursquare.com|access-date=2015-04-10}} Danube opened its first hypermarket in Riyadh's [[Hayat Mall]] in 2006 and built its second at [[Panorama Mall]] in 2010.{{Cite web|date=2018-09-30|title=Danube begins 15-day French food festival in Saudi Arabia|url=https://www.arabnews.com/node/1380231/corporate-news|access-date=2020-09-03|website=Arab News|language=en}}{{Cite web|title=افتتاح الفرع الثاني للدانوب بالمنطقة الوسطى في بانوراما مول بالرياض|url=http://www.alriyadh.com/522991|access-date=2020-09-03|website=جريدة الرياض|language=ar}}{{cite web|title=Danube Hypermarket opens its second branch in Riyadh | Business | Saudi Gazette|url=http://www.saudigazette.com.sa/index.cfm?method=home.regcon&contentID=2010013161854&archiveissuedate=31/01/2010|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150417165913/http://www.saudigazette.com.sa/index.cfm?method=home.regcon&contentID=2010013161854&archiveissuedate=31%2F01%2F2010|archive-date=2015-04-17|access-date=2015-04-10|publisher=saudigazette.com.sa}} Danube has 47 store locations across the Kingdom and Danube Online is live in Jeddah, Riyadh, Al Khobar, Dammam and Taif.{{cite news |date=16 June 2020 |title=Retail mogul Ahmad BinDawood grapples with coronavirus challenge |work=www.ft.com |url=https://www.ft.com/content/71b880fe-6848-11ea-a6ac-9122541af204}}{{cite news |title=BinDawood opens Danube hypermarket in Taif |url=https://www.arabnews.com/node/1483581/corporate-news |work=Arab News |date=16 April 2019 |language=en}} == Online presence == Danube Online was launched in 2017,{{Cite web|date=2020-05-18|title=Danube Online lists nongrocery items on Noon.com|url=https://arab.news/mdprz|access-date=2020-09-02|website=Arab News|language=en}} a first mover in the eCommerce grocery space in Saudi Arabia, and available via digital platform and mobile app which offer fully integrated services. Danube Online delivers Danube grocery products in six cities across the Kingdom.{{Cite web|date=2019-11-28|title=Health comes first for Danube Online shoppers|url=https://www.arabnews.com/node/1590776/corporate-news|access-date=2020-09-02|website=Arab News|language=en}}{{Cite web|last=East|first=Forbes Middle|title=New App Set To Innovate Saudi's
